messages:
Ashley: Quick heads-up — found a 403 on an inline image and an old gist shortlink on a few KB pages under /kb/runtime. The scanner flagged them as "orphan assets" and there isn't an owner listed. Anyone able to take a quick rehost + redirect PR?

Jonah: Which pages exactly? can you paste one example so I can triage locally?

Ashley: Sure — e.g. https://kb.internal/redwood/runtime/chef-troubleshooting (render shows missing image and a link to gist.github.com/old/snippets). Curl output shows 403 for the image:```
curl -I https://s3-legacy.internal/teams/docs/runtime/chef-diag.png
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
```

Marie: I can pick this up — plan: rehost the image in assets.redwood (publicly served), update the md to point at the new path, and replace the gist with our snippets system. Quick sed I use locally:```
find docs/kb/runtime -name '*.md' -exec sed -i "s|https://s3-legacy.internal/teams/docs/runtime/chef-diag.png|/assets/docs/runtime/chef-diag.png|g" {} +
```
Will also add frontmatter redirect for the old shortlink if needed. :+1:

docs-bot: Automated scan result: orphan-image detected in /kb/runtime/chef-troubleshooting — no codeowners found. Marked severity: low.

Oliver: FYI if you swap out the gist link, prefer migrating the snippet into /snippets and referencing via our include macro so it gets tested. Also ensure alt text is included to satisfy the image linter.

Marie: Good call. I'll add an include like `{{< snippet "chef-diagnose-commands" >}}` and add `alt: "chef diag screenshot"` in the image frontmatter. ETA: today EOD. I'll open a PR and drop the link here.

Jonah: I'll review when you post the PR. Heads-up: CI will fail if the new path isn't present in the assets bucket policy; if CI complains ping infra for a quick allowlist.

Ashley: Thanks all. If anyone else sees similar 403s, paste them here and we'll batch the rehosts.

Marie: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4321 — includes rehosted image, snippet migration, and a short redirect entry. Requesting review from @Jonah and @Oliver. :eyes:

Jonah: Reviewing now. Quick note — add `alt` and small caption in the md to silence a11y lint.

Marie: Added alt + caption, pushed. CI passed for docs build. Leaving the infra allowlist follow-up in the PR description.

Ashley: Awesome — thanks @Marie and @Jonah. Marking this thread as the batch starter for runtime asset rehosts.
